hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$(basename "$f")" in .env|.env.*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Reading .env files is blocked by policy"}}';; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | { read -r c; if echo "$c" | grep -Eq '\.env([^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Access to .env files via Bash is blocked by policy"}}'; fi; }
